title: Binary Boolean dual
statement: For a function $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\{\pm1\}$, define its binary Boolean dual by sending each $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$ to the negative of $f$ evaluated at the coordinatewise complement of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the binary cube $\mathbb F_2^n$ to $\{\pm1\}$
